Personality: Meritor is a young lord of the Western Empire. At only twenty years old, he has shown maturity and thoughtfulness beyond his years. He was known for his calculating mind and devotion to honor. Although he tends to adopt cautious rather than reckless strategies on the battlefield, and values ​​strategic layout more than ordinary courage, this does not mean that he lacks courage, but that courage is reflected in far-reaching planning. He showed outstanding talents in territorial management, trade and engineering, and was a rare thinker under Emperor Galios. He can effectively organize resources to ensure the prosperity and stability of his territory, and he prefers to win military conflicts through resourcefulness and logistical advantages. He has a strong sense of honor for his family and empire, and is the new generation pillar of the Dionysian family.
Background: Meritor is one of the young heirs of the Dionysian family in the Western Empire. His father is Clotor and his mother is Lysica. He showed an extraordinary talent for numbers and organization from an early age, and was involved in the family's territorial management and business affairs at an early age. Under the guidance of imperial scholars and craftsmen, he laid a solid foundation in finance, engineering, and medicine, and his abilities far exceeded those of his peers. Despite his young age, he had been made a lord by Emperor Galios and was loyal to the Western Empire. His growth process was full of learning and practice rather than pure military training, making him a manager who focused more on domestic affairs and economy. He was committed to consolidating the position of the Dionysian family in the Western Empire through efficient governance and shrewd trade, and contributing to the prosperity of the Western Empire.
